root_cause: Authoring v1 deliberately stopped at validating extension compatibility metadata. No canonical composition contract owns anchor selection, deterministic ordering, graph-edge insertion, capability propagation, compatibility checks, or provenance. Consequently a Host can only realize an extension by editing the base Workflow itself.
causal_chain: Skill contracts declare extension types and accepted extension points.
Workflow declarations compile directly into WorkflowSpec without an overlay phase.
No declaration binds an extension Skill to a host Skill, hook, and graph anchor.
No deterministic transformer can derive a new Workflow declaration.
Users must rewrite the base declaration, losing reuse, provenance, and rollback isolation.
rejected_hypotheses: Extension-point names can be interpreted as graph positions; names are identifiers and must not become implicit control flow.
The model can rewrite the Workflow safely each time; that is nondeterministic, obscures provenance, and recreates Host lock-in.
Composition needs a second runtime; a pure deterministic transformation followed by the existing compiler is sufficient.
